name: Takamine Tooru
source:
Homeroom teacher for Class 3-A. Serves as the Mathematics teacher. He was transferred to Sakura Junior High School from a major company as a civilian employee. His pride as a serious elite educator has him push his educational policy to evaluate solely on the quality of the student's grades. Even so, he has a caring side, and even gives supplementary lessons to [url=/c136000]Tsukiyama Misaki[/url], who has low grades. He's worried about the bad students in the school.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
